title: Decoupling Parcellation from Classification: Systematic Benchmark of Fast Brain Segmentation Methods for Alzheimer's Disease Detection
abstract: arXiv:2608.16039v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Brain parcellation and classification are typically evaluated in isolation, yet downstream AD detection performance depends on their interaction. We decouple these components and systematically benchmark fast deep learning parcellation methods (SynthSeg+, OpenMAP-T1) against the FreeSurfer (FS-HV) clinical baseline through down- stream AD classification on OASIS-1. Our factorial design evaluates three parcellation methods, two volumetry strategies (hard vs. soft), and four classifier paradigms (clinical thresholds, supervised feedforward networks, ensemble methods, and foundation models with zero/few-shot prompting), with all results quantified using BCa Bootstrap 95% confidence intervals.

translated_title: 解耦分割与分类：面向阿尔茨海默病检测的快速脑部分割方法系统性基准研究
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.16039v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：脑部分割和分类通常被孤立评估，然而下游的阿尔茨海默病（AD）检测性能依赖于它们之间的交互。我们将这些组件解耦，并通过在OASIS-1数据集上的下游AD分类，系统地基准测试快速深度学习分割方法（SynthSeg+、OpenMAP-T1）与FreeSurfer（FS-HV）临床基线。我们的因子设计评估了三种分割方法、两种体积测量策略（硬分割与软分割）以及四种分类器范式（临床阈值、监督前馈网络、集成方法和具有零/少样本提示的基础模型），所有结果均使用BCa Bootstrap 95%置信区间进行量化。
tldr: 该论文首次将脑部分割与分类解耦，系统比较了快速深度学习方法与临床基线在阿尔茨海默病检测中的交互影响，为分割方法选择提供了实证基准。
en_tdlr: This paper decouples brain parcellation from classification, systematically benchmarking fast deep learning methods against clinical baselines for Alzheimer's disease detection, providing empirical guidance on their interaction.
